item.description: Mimo 0.1.7 English - Added live Top 5 traffic rankings to the menu bar, with domain and process views. Connections are grouped and ranked by combined upload and download speed. - Added domain favicons and process icons. Each row shows upload on the left and download on the right; the panel adapts to smaller screens. - Fixed release notes wrapping and restored the native font in update dialogs. - Fixed blank or incorrectly positioned log rows after switching source filters while following the latest entries. 简体中文 - 菜单栏新增实时流量 Top 5，可在域名和进程间切换；合并同类连接，按上下行合计速率排序。 - 域名显示 favicon，进程显示应用图标；速率统一为左侧上行、右侧下行，面板适配小屏空间。 - 修复更新窗口中更新说明不自动换行的问题，并使用系统字体。 - 修复跟随最新日志时，切换来源筛选后列表空白或滚动位置错误的问题。

Mimo 0.1.6 English - Refined the menu bar panel with per-profile pinned policy groups, inline expansion and profile switching. Added Dashboard and Remote Controller shortcuts, removed duplicate traffic charts and the power button, and unified action rows and the native window material. - Added instant switching between Simplified Chinese and English, plus a dashboard control to show or hide IP addresses. - Expanded Remote Controller column customization and added custom proxy-set names to connection details. - Replaced the system chart with a compact resource bar and added application memory alongside core metrics. - Fixed extra table-header borders, incorrect horizontal-scroller viewport binding and clipped detail scrollers; normalized the MIPS stack label. 简体中文 - 优化菜单栏面板：支持按配置置顶策略组、面板内展开和配置切换；新增仪表盘与远程控制器入口，移除重复流量图和电源按钮，统一操作行及原生窗口材质。 - 新增简体中文与英文即时切换，以及仪表盘 IP 地址显示开关。 - 扩展远程控制器的列自定义选项，连接详情显示自定义远程代理集名称。 - 使用紧凑资源条替代系统图表，并在内核指标旁显示应用内存。 - 修复列表表头多余边框、水平滚动条控制错误视口及连接详情滚动条裁切的问题，统一 MIPS 协议栈标签。

Mimo 0.1.5

English
- Ordinary app updates now reuse Enhanced Service authorization when the service code, security properties and signing identity are unchanged.
- Kept native signature, user identity, file permission and integrity checks.
- Unified policy group type names as select, url-test, fallback and load-balance in both languages, and removed decorative type-picker icons.
- Existing Enhanced Service installations require one administrator authorization to migrate to this mechanism when next used.

简体中文
- 优化增强服务授权流程：服务代码、安全属性和签名身份未变化时，普通应用更新复用已有授权。
- 保留原生签名、用户身份、文件权限和完整性校验。
- 策略组类型在中英文界面统一使用 select、url-test、fallback、load-balance，并移除类型菜单的装饰图标。
- 已安装的增强服务下次使用时仍需授权一次，以迁移到新的授权机制。
